lessons_used: Predictions were consistently too optimistic across all tests compared to measured outcomes.
Evidence remains thin for all specific change types (sign_in reorder, home redesign, finish layout, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, home notification) as each has only been tested once.
No kinds of change have been proven helpful yet, as no tests have won.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Pet Carousel View
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a carousel layout with playful animation cards to make choosing a pet more engaging.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a 60.9% conversion rate and long completion times (median 89s / mean 1017s), showing users hesitate during pet selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection screen into a carousel while preserving its function and step requirement.

candidates.score_note: Targets the highest dropoff step (60.9% adoption rate), but redesigns carry high risk of neutral or negative lift.

candidates.title: Pet Habitat Preview Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a pre-choice pet habitat preview screen showcasing desktop pet interactions before selecting an adoption path.
candidates.why: Choose path dropoff (76.2% conversion, mean 514s) and post-onboarding support confusion indicate users need early context.

new_welcome_preview.headline: Meet Your Virtual Pet
new_welcome_preview.body: See how your pet lives on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: Adds a new habitat preview screen within onboarding without removing or skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases friction despite addressing user confusion noted in support context.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Dashboard
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a checklist progress dashboard showing pet creation steps with estimated time remaining.
candidates.why: Home waiting step takes a median of 201s (mean 2336s) and conversion drops to 81.3%, leading users to suspect the app stalled.

guard.reason: Redesigns the waiting screen layout while maintaining its core job and showing a real progress time estimate.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time, but home redesigns previously produced 0.0% lift at high implementation cost.

candidates.title: Home Intro Companion Celebration Screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing the pet's arrival celebration and clear onboarding completion CTA.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% with median time 395s, indicating user drop-off right before completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet Has Arrived!
home_intro.body: Say hello to your new desktop buddy and start interacting.

guard.reason: Redesigns the home intro screen layout within allowed onboarding scope.

candidates.score_note: Targets low finish conversion (64.8%), but past finish layout changes resulted in -2.5% lift.

candidates.title: Account Protection Notice Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated account protection screen right before sign-in highlighting cloud save security and pet recovery features.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails complaining about missing or reset pets after re-login, highlighting account awareness gaps.

new_account_reassurance.headline: Keep Your Desktop Pet Safe
new_account_reassurance.body: Your pet progress and adoption settings are backed up securely to your account.

guard.reason: screen 'new_account_reassurance' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Account Sync Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Display a clear persistence tip below the sign-in options explaining that signing in prevents pet loss across desktop sessions.
candidates.why: Support mail logged 8 complaints of lost or reset pets after re-authenticating.

sign_in.hint: Signing in connects your pet to your account so you never lose progress.

guard.reason: Adds a persistent sign-in hint explaining cloud save without dark patterns or rule violations.

candidates.score_note: Strongly supported by 8 support emails and funnel dropoff; low-friction text hint with high feasibility.

candidates.title: Desktop Generation Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add a rotating tip carousel component on the waiting screen explaining background pet processing.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and leads to user friction or app abandonment.

components.text: Your pet will live quietly in your system tray when minimized.

guard.reason: Adds an informative tip carousel component to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Minor info component targeting high wait times; aligns with slightly positive home notification test (+0.6%).

candidates.title: Path Choice Value Proposition Copy
candidates.change: Update the headline and body of the choose_path screen to highlight instant pet adoption versus custom pet creation.
candidates.why: Choose path conversion is 76.2% with long mean time (514s), showing users need clearer expectations before choosing.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Adopt Your Desktop Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a quick starter pet or create a custom companion from your photos.

guard.reason: Updates onboarding copy on choose_path while continuing to offer both adoption options.

candidates.score_note: Choose path copy changes achieved the best historical result (+1.2%) and require zero UI redesign.

candidates.title: Customization Bonus Badge Incentive
candidates.change: Add a special starter badge component to photo upload reassuring users that photo generation unlocks exclusive pet items.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low conversion (60.9%) and support receives feedback about failed or wrong custom pet creation.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions bonus gifts/free extras ('Unlocks Exclusive Starter Accessories').

candidates.title: Story Screen Visual Scroll Storytelling
candidates.change: Update the story screen layout to story_scroll to present the intro narrative as a smooth visual scroll before path selection.
candidates.why: Median story/choose_path time has a high mean (514s), suggesting users stall on the initial static story presentation.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet Journey

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen layout while preserving its storytelling function.

candidates.score_note: Layout revamp carries execution risk and cost without proven success in prior layout tests.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally overoptimistic for non-winning tests, but underpredicted gains for the winning tests.
sign_in hint and home wait_info were helpful changes, as both won their tests.
choose_path copy changes showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Evidence remains thin for all other specific change types as each has only been tested once.
